title: Speaking — Sound in daily life
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on sound in daily life.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
Which sounds remind you of your neighbourhood?
Do you prefer quiet when you are at home?

part2.topic: Describe a sound that reminds you of a specific experience.
part2.closing: and explain why it stayed in your memory.

questions: How can urban planners reduce harmful noise without making streets lifeless?
What types of noise are people willing to accept in shared places?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to sound in daily life?
